note: exploratory definitions, same chains as the registered metrics (cv_nearest on the strategy's own detections)

defs.L1_launch: an observed point with speed >= 10 px/ref frame preceded within 2 processed frames by an observed point with speed <= 6 and followed by upward motion (y falls over the next 3 observed points)
defs.L2_chain_starts_in_hand: the chain's first observed point is at least 3 observed points before the first point of speed >= 10 (the approach to launch is observed, any speed)
defs.L3_start_before_apex: the chain's observed points begin at least 8 reference frames before its minimum-y point (rising flight observed from its early part)
